components.name: Memory Synapse Code Stream
components.description: Frameless obsidian screen streaming synchronized working memory experiences

action.description: Memory action: 'write' (atomically store verified solution with at least 10 keywords and evidence linking), 'search' (keyword/semantic query across memories), 'read' (fetch full memory file by id or slug), 'list' (catalog stored memories), 'purge' (delete memory).

title.description: Technical descriptive title of the solution in English (for action: 'write').

keywords.description: Array of at least 10 technical keywords in English covering symptoms, tools, root causes, commands, and verified fixes (for action: 'write').

source_session_id.description: Session ID from caller context linking this memory to its origin trajectory (Evidence Linking standard).

evidence_steps.description: Array of step index integers where terminal commands verified Exit Code 0 for this fix (Evidence Linking standard).

verified_exit_code.description: Numeric exit code verifying successful execution (must be 0 for validated solutions).

release_tag.description: Optional release version tag (e.g. 'v1.0.1') associated with this crystallized capability.

id.description: Unique memory ID or filename slug (for action: 'read', 'write', or 'purge').

problem.description: Detailed description of the issue, error logs, and context (for action: 'write').

root_cause.description: Optional root cause analysis explaining why the issue occurred (for action: 'write').

solution.description: The exact verified fix, configuration changes, or commands that produced Exit Code 0 (for action: 'write').

query.description: Search query keywords or problem terms (for action: 'search').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (for action: 'search' or 'list', default: 10).

overwrite.description: Set to true to overwrite existing memory with the same ID (for action: 'write').

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining WHY you are calling this tool right now and what specific action it performs.
